gap: No result ChatGPT got states the exact charge cutoff that decides winter solar charging: Redodo's BMS stops charging below 32°F (0°C) and does not start again until the cells are back above 41°F (5°C). Its self-heating model uses 100 W pads to warm the pack to 41°F before charging resumes, and Sun Gold Power's SGH48100T rack battery starts heating below 41°F and stops at 53.6°F.
standout_why: I read the cited BLUETTI guide (bluettipower.com, 2026-09-30). It says LFP 'should not be charged below freezing unless the product manual specifically confirms' a cutoff, that some BMSs 'cut off charging entirely', and that self-heating is 'product-specific'. So the mechanism is partly covered already. It gives no cutoff or restart temperatures, says nothing about heater thresholds, and names no product that has or lacks the protection. I could not open the other cited page, SAVYEN (self-signed certificate error, and a raw fetch was not approved), so I can't rule out that it covers this. I also did not open the uncited cpv24.pl 'LiFePO4 in winter' result, which may cover frost charging in general terms.
decides: If the battery sits somewhere unheated (shed, cabin, RV), the BMS blocks all solar charging below 32°F and keeps blocking it until the cells are back above 41°F, so a cold battery can miss a whole day of sun. That points cold-climate buyers to a self-heating model (Redodo 12V 100Ah Self-Heating at $251.99, or Sun Gold SGH48100T at $1,035 against $981 for the plain SG48100P), not just a 'low-temp protection' model like the WEIZE ChatGPT showed. For a battery kept indoors, the plain low-temp-cutoff models are enough.

findings.label: Heater on/off temperatures and charge interlock
findings.value: Heating starts below 32°F (0°C) and stops at 41°F (5°C). Charging 'halts until the heating pads raise the battery's temperature above 41°F'. Pads: 100 W dual.
findings.source_title: Redodo 12V 100Ah Self-Heating Lithium Battery | For RV, Boats, and Solar Home Systems
findings.note: Text is from the maker's store product data, read with storecheck.py search. Later attempts to open the full page and spec block returned HTTP 429.

findings.label: Low-temp charge cutoff and restart point (no heater)
findings.value: Charging pauses below 32°F (0°C) and resumes above 41°F (5°C). Discharging stops below -4°F (-20°C).
findings.note: The Redodo 12V 100Ah trolling-motor battery page gives the same 32°F cut and 41°F resume. Without a heater, nothing warms the cells, so solar charging stays blocked until the surroundings bring them above 41°F.

findings.label: Price and series/parallel limit
findings.note: Read with storecheck.py search. The product text says only 'added low-temperature cut-off protection' and gives no thresholds.

findings.label: Heater thresholds
findings.value: Heating starts below 41°F (5°C) and stops at 53.6°F (12°C). Also has low-temperature charging protection. Price $1,035. Max 32 in parallel. RS485 and CAN.
findings.source_title: SGH48100T Server Rack 48V 100AH Lithium Battery Self-Heating
findings.note: Read with storecheck.py search on sungoldpower.com. This heater turns on above freezing, so it keeps the pack above the charge cutoff instead of recovering from it.

findings.label: Price, communications, parallel limit
findings.value: $981. CAN/RS485/RS232. Max 63 in parallel (322.56 kWh). Store lists Growatt, Deye, SunGoldPower, Luxpower, Victron, Schneider, Phocos, SMK as compatible inverters.
findings.source_title: 48V 100AH Server Rack LiFePO4 Lithium Battery SG48100P UL1973 UL9540A
findings.note: Read with storecheck.py search. Unlike the SGH48100T text, this product text lists no low-temperature charging protection or heater, only overcharge, deep discharge, overload, overheating and short circuit.
